text: There is that of God in everyone.
Attend to what love requires of you.
Take heed, dear Friends, to the promptings of love and truth in your hearts.
Walk cheerfully over the world, answering that of God in every one.
Be patterns, be examples in all countries, places, islands, nations, wherever you come.
Simplicity, truth, equality, and peace are the testimonies of Friends.
The humble, meek, merciful, just, pious, and devout souls are everywhere of one religion.
True godliness does not turn men out of the world, but enables them to live better in it.
Live adventurously. When choices arise, do you take the way that offers the fullest opportunity for the use of your gifts in the service of God and the community? Let your life speak.
